notes: Investment gold of 99%+ purity is zero-rated; jewelry and lower-purity gold carry 15% VAT on gold plus making. Bar premiums are Ounce (Riyadh) Saudi-brand bar asks at 09:00 on 27 Nov vs the 24K raw rate it shows (439.28 SAR/g, equal to spot). Making is quoted 10-20% for 21K; 24K bullion needs little. Used-gold deduction from gold.sa and ZahabPrice market averages (indicative).
